description_en: Stops one or more simple application servers
description_zh: 停止一台或多台轻量应用服务器
name: StopInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate the parameter value on your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly stop the instance.

true: forcibly stops the instance.

false (default): normally stops the instance
parameters.help_zh:
停止实例时是否强制关机策略。

true：强制关机。

false（默认）：正常关机流程
parameters.name: force_stop
